name: Fourthwall Alerts
description: A Fourthwall donation lands on your stream as an alert: who sent it and how much, written the way you write money, with a sound, a spoken line and a message in chat. It shows inside every overlay you have in OBS. Installs the alert and connects Fourthwall: one click through its consent screen, then send yourself a test notification from Fourthwall's admin and watch it land.
changelog: First release: Fourthwall alerts as a product of their own.
ready_message: Your Fourthwall alert is built and listening for tips.
notes: A test notification from Fourthwall's admin travels the whole way, so it proves more than anything Overlabels could fake.
Once Fourthwall is connected, its donation counter and latest donor are controls of yours for any overlay you write: [[[c:fourthwall:donations_received]]] and [[[c:fourthwall:latest_donor_name]]].
